decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures exclusion of old-contract NFT copies from the dashboard and use of the new active contract.
The existing same-message MODIFY already restricts public referral statistics to new-contract activity and excludes old-contract referral data.
The existing same-message MODIFY already scopes referral rewards and prize-ticket accounting to the new active contract.
The existing same-message MODIFY already establishes new-contract mint numbers restarting at NFT #1 as referral codes and excludes old-contract numbers.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits random no-code reward recipients to NFT holders in the new active contract.
The existing same-message MODIFY already makes only new-contract minted NFT numbers valid and excludes old-contract mint numbers.
The existing same-message MODIFY already restarts draw and ticket state under the new active contract and excludes old-contract NFTs.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits eligibility to new-contract tickets and restarts draw state without carrying forward old-contract state.
The contract migration does not change which metadata fields must be visible; the old contract remains extant, and exclusion from project systems does not remove its on-chain metadata.
Restarting NFT numbering and excluding old-contract copies does not change the badge set, icons, count, or grid layout.
The contract migration does not change the requirement to display the complete NFT book cover without cropping.
The decision to use new-contract NFTs does not change the referral milestones or conditions that award badges.
